notes: GAAP audit. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p7; row labels on p6). Fund balance roll-forward ties: 6,948,290 + 8,926,955 - 8,251,670 + 602,091 - 715,690 = 7,509,976. Ending cash = Cash and cash equivalents, Total Governmental Funds balance sheet (p5); CDs 1,265,911 in ending_investments; County treasurer cash 50,933 printed separately; no beginning cash printed. Internal service fund (governmental activities) is not in the governmental funds statements and is not recorded. Business-type: Water and Wastewater enterprise funds, Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (p9); 'Other revenue' 48,814 is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities, so charges for services; disbursement total = Total business-type activities expenses 1,940,419 (p2). Transfers: governmental in 602,091 (Capital Projects 516,336, Grants 85,755), out 715,690 (General 513,091, Street 73,000, Capital Projects 43,099, Infrastructure 86,500); net 113,599 to Water 78,500 and Wastewater 35,099. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), component units excluded. Detail: General Fund from the Combining Statement of Revenues and Expenditures - General Fund Departments (pp17-18; more detailed than the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule p12, which is therefore not recorded); Street, Capital Projects and Economic Development budgetary comparison schedules (pp13-15, budgetary basis, actual column); nonmajor combining statement per fund (p16). Debt Service and Aquatic Center funds have no schedule in the trimmed PDF. Airport function has no matching category (other, review); Handibus counted under Public works by the report.
